channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Mychal Mulder | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Mychal Mulder from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Damion Lee, Mychal Mulder
item.description:
Wes Goldberg:Steve Kerr:

“Mychal Mulder has really taken his opportunity and run with it these last couple of weeks after Damion went out,and I think that's one of the keys to our strong play of late.”

Steve Kerr on Damion Lee, Mychal Mulder, May 11, 2021. Source: Twitter @wcgoldberg.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Stephen Curry, Draymond Green, Nico Mannion, Mychal Mulder, Jordan Poole
item.description:
“I’m not taking Draymond Green or Steph (Curry) out if they miss a box-out, I’ll be perfectly honest. I’ll tell them at the next timeout,‘Hey, let’s make sure we box out,’ and they usually know when they miss one. But a young guy, a Jordan Poole, Mike Mulder, Nico Mannion, Juan — if Juan were to miss one — sure. It’s a good way to remind them, ‘Hey, if you want to play, you gotta do this every time.’ I wouldn’t hesitate to take one of those guys out.”

Steve Kerr on Stephen Curry, Draymond Green, Nico Mannion, Mychal Mulder, Jordan Poole, Mar 4, 2021. Source: San Francisco Chronicle.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Mychal Mulder
item.description:
Drew Shiller:Steve Kerr on Mychal Mulder's contract now being fully guaranteed for rest of season:

“Just a great human being, great teammate. And anybody who stays ready and produces when you call him -- and stays professional when not playing -- those guys are great assets to a team.”

Steve Kerr on Mychal Mulder, Feb 24, 2021. Source: Twitter @DrewShiller.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Mychal Mulder
item.description:
Drew Shiller:Steve Kerr on Mychal Mulder's chances of getting the 15th and final roster spot:

“He's here, so he's on the roster for a reason ... we love Mike. He's gonna be on the roster.”

Steve Kerr on Mychal Mulder, Dec 19, 2020. Source: Twitter @DrewShiller.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Mychal Mulder
item.description:
Connor Letourneau:Steve Kerr on Mychal Mulder:

“I didn't know anything about him when we signed him, had no idea who he was.... He's played well the last couple games. We appreciate not only his shooting and his defense, but his toughness.”

Steve Kerr on Mychal Mulder, Mar 5, 2020. Source: Twitter @Con_Chron.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Mychal Mulder
item.description:
Connor Letourneau:Steve Kerr on Mychal Mulder:

“I know he's an excellent shooter, shot it really well in the G League. We'll probably get him out there tonight.”

Steve Kerr on Mychal Mulder, Feb 27, 2020. Source: Twitter @Con_Chron.
